γάμου: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. gen. sg.: ’of marriage’
εἰσίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl.: ’they are’ (Attic form, alongside the epic by-form ἔασιν)
εἶβεν: εἴβω — let fall, shed (poetic by-form of λείβω); impf. 3 sg., epic εἶβεν (= ἔλειβεν)
κάλλιον: καλός — good, fine, fair; comparative κάλλιον, neut. nom./acc. sg. used predicatively: ’better, finer’
καλέσειε: καλέω — call, summon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish: ’let him call, may he call’
κλαῖε: κλαίω — weep, mourn; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιε): ’wept’
κτέρεα: κτέρεα — funeral honours, funeral gifts (pl.); neut. acc. pl.
κόνι: κόνις — dust, ashes; fem. dat. sg. (= Attic κόνει)
λύσῃ: λύω — loose, release, free; aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα κε: ’may set free’
μέσσαυλον: μέσσαυλος — the court or yard in the middle of the steading; neut. acc. sg., epic double σσ (= μέσαυλον)
μί: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg., elided (μί’ = μία): ’one (only)’
νείκεσσε: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile, rebuke; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐνείκεσε)
πάθεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπαθεν)
πανδαμάτωρ: πανδαμάτωρ — all-subduing, all-conquering; adj., masc. nom. sg. (epithet of sleep)
πείρων: πείρω — pierce, run through, make one’s way through; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. (of passing through wars and waves)
ποθέων: ποθέω — long for, miss; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθῶν)
προπρηνέα: προπρηνής — face down, headlong, prone; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic πρηνής): ’face forward’
πτολέμους: πτόλεμος — war, battle (epic = πόλεμος); masc. acc. pl.
σχέτλιοί: σχέτλιος — cruel, hard-hearted, stubborn; masc. nom. pl., word of reproach
τέκεϊ: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
ταρπήμεναι: τέρπω (aor. pass. ἐτάρπην) — take one’s fill, be satisfied (+ gen.); aor. pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (Attic ταρπῆναι)
τολύπευσε: τολυπεύω — wind off, bring to an end (a war); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτολύπευσε)
φόρμιγγα: φόρμιγξ — lyre, the singer’s stringed instrument; fem. acc. sg.
ἀλεγεινά: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; neut. acc. pl., accented before enclitic τε
ἀλύων: ἀλύω — be distraught, beside oneself (with pain or distress); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀργεϊφόντην: Ἀργεϊφόντης — Argeïphontes, epithet of Hermes, traditionally ’slayer of Argus’ though the sense is disputed; acc. sg.
ἐλεαίρων: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity, have compassion on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἐναίσιμοι: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure, true (of an omen); masc. nom. pl.
ἔκηε: καίω — burn; aor. 3 sg., Homeric lengthened-vowel form (beside Attic ἔκαυσα): ‘he burned’
ὀλοῷ: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; masc. dat. sg.
ὁμὴν: ὁμός — same, common; fem. acc. sg.
